settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.ldap_help: Let the users of an NS8 user domain, OpenLDAP or Active Directory, sign in to Metabase with their directory password. The accounts created in Metabase, including the administrator, keep working with their own password.
settings.ldap_domain_help: Choose None to turn the directory login off.
settings.ldap_active_description: Users of {domain} ({schema}) can sign in to Metabase with their directory credentials.
settings.ldap_inactive_description: User domain {domain} cannot be used now: {reason} Metabase keeps running and its own accounts can still sign in. The login starts working again when the domain is available.
settings.ldap_no_domains: This node has no OpenLDAP or Active Directory user domain yet. Create one in Domains and users, then come back to this page.
settings.ldap_signin_hint: Users sign in on the Metabase login page with their user name or their email address and their directory password. Their Metabase account is created at the first sign-in. Directory users need an email address, otherwise they cannot sign in.
settings.ldap_domain_unavailable: The selected user domain does not exist.
settings.ldap_proxy_unreachable: The LDAP proxy of this node cannot reach the user domain. Check that its account provider is running.
settings.ldap_schema_unsupported: Only OpenLDAP and Active Directory user domains can be used.
settings.admin_help: Metabase asks whoever opens the site first to create the administrator. To avoid that, enter an email address and a password: the module creates the account as soon as Metabase starts. Leave both empty to create it in the browser.
settings.admin_password_help: 12 to 72 characters. The password is stored in a private file only until the account is created, and is never shown again.
settings.admin_pending: The account {email} will be created when Metabase is ready. Save again to retry.
settings.admin_exists: The module never changes existing accounts. Manage administrators and passwords in Metabase, under Admin settings, People.
settings.admin_password_length: The password must be 12 to 72 characters long.
settings.admin_password_invalid: The password cannot contain control characters.
settings.admin_already_created: Metabase already has an account: the administrator cannot be created here.
